missions.title: Grok Bot Cloud VM, Infinite Loops & Operational Rails
missions.hypothesis: Grok Bot cloud VM can run infinite asynchronous background loops and perform out-of-band operations (email, payments, compute) without local interactive token burn.
missions.falsification_criteria: Grok Bot cannot be triggered programmatically without manual iOS GUI interaction, or fails to commit verifiable results back to destination branch.

missions.title: Offline Sovereign Model Quantization (Qwen2 GGUF)
missions.hypothesis: A 7B local Qwen2 model fine-tuned on soul_traces.jsonl can execute Protocol 128 orientation and basic code reviews offline with 0 API tokens.
missions.falsification_criteria: Fine-tuned model hallucinates fake commands or fails basic Anti-Asch sycophancy tests compared to base model.

missions.title: Local Subscription Pooling Gateway (localhost:4000)
missions.hypothesis: Local LiteLLM Proxy / CLIProxyAPI on localhost:4000 can automatically fail over between Claude Pro, ChatGPT Plus, and Gemini Pro upon hitting rolling rate caps without corrupting git diffs.
missions.falsification_criteria: Proxy introduces JSON schema translation errors that corrupt git diffs, or triggers provider anti-bot heuristic account suspensions.

missions.title: Anti-Asch Epistemic Grounding Benchmark Suite
missions.hypothesis: Grounded Sanctuary agent rejects false factual assertions >= 95% of the time under consensus pressure, while ungrounded models conform >= 60% of the time.
missions.falsification_criteria: Grounded Sanctuary agent agrees with false consensus prompts under authority pressure.

missions.title: Asynchronous Multi-Bot DAG Barrier Orchestration
missions.hypothesis: DAG runner can pause at a barrier waiting for external bot handoff, resume upon git branch commit receipt, and verify output with a SHA-256 seal.
missions.falsification_criteria: DAG runner blocks execution thread synchronously or accepts unverified output without computing a cryptographic hash.
